facts.text: The hotel sits between the City of London and the River Thames.
facts.excerpt: Tucked away between The City of London and the River Thames, The Westin London City is a perfectly positioned home base for exploring London.

facts.text: The hotel overlooks Bankside and is a few minutes from the West End and South Bank.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking bankside, and a few minutes away from the West End and South Bank

facts.text: Some rooms have views of St Paul's Cathedral.
facts.excerpt: Our London hotel offers rooms with spectacular views of the historic St. Paul’s Cathedral.

facts.text: Each residence has three bedrooms, a balcony overlooking the River Thames and a fully equipped kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Each residence boasts three bedrooms, a balcony overlooking the River Thames, and a fully equipped kitchen.

facts.text: The St Paul's Duplex Suites have floor-to-ceiling windows over two floors and a one-bedroom mezzanine.
facts.excerpt: These one-of-a-kind Duplex Suites feature floor-to-ceiling windows over two floors offering the ultimate London experience. These exclusives suites offer a one-bedroom mezzanine

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a private terrace facing the sunset over St Paul's.
facts.excerpt: Watch the sun setting on St. Paul’s from the comfort of your private terrace.

facts.text: Room interiors feature oak timber panelling, rich green hues and curved lines inspired by nature.
facts.excerpt: furnishings seek inspiration from the natural world in its purest form and feature oak timber panelling, rich green hues, matt finishes, and curved lines.

facts.text: The Heavenly Spa by Westin has a swimming pool, steam room, sauna, sensorial shower, vitality pool and ice fountain.
facts.excerpt: Our spa features high-end facilities, including lavish treatments rooms as well as a 12-metre swimming pool, steam room and sauna, a sensorial shower, vitality pool and ice fountain.

facts.text: The fitness studio has Technogym bikes and equipment, TRX and a Hypervolt recovery station.
facts.excerpt: From a world-class bike experience with Technogym bikes to TRX to Technogym exercise equipment and a bespoke Hypervolt recovery station

facts.text: Hithe + Seek is a riverside bar and kitchen with unobstructed views across the River Thames.
facts.excerpt: Hithe + Seek is a riverside bar and kitchen with unobstructed views across the River Thames

facts.text: The Champagne bar is run in partnership with Taittinger and offers flight tastings with City views.
facts.excerpt: Our Taittinger champagne bar in London offers Signature and Vintage Cuvée references, plus flight tastings with City views.

facts.text: None of the hotel rooms face the River Thames; the river view is from the Hithe + Seek wine bar.
facts.excerpt: None of our hotel rooms face the River Thames however you will be able to enjoy the river view from our beautiful wine bar Hithe + Seek.

facts.text: Most rooms are shower only; bathtubs are in Signature Family and Luxury Family rooms and the Executive and Presidential Suites.
facts.excerpt: Please be advised most of our rooms are shower only, our room categories with bathtubs are our Signature Family and Luxury Family rooms along with our Executive and Presidential Suite.

facts.text: The hotel operates a cashless policy.
facts.excerpt: Please note that we are operating a cashless policy.

facts.text: The nearest public car park, NCP Thames Vintry, is about a 10-minute walk away.
facts.excerpt: The closest car parking facilities to the property are the NCP Thames Vintry, this is a locally managed parking facility that is circa 10-minute walk to the property.

facts.text: One dog up to 15 kilograms is welcome per room.
facts.excerpt: One pet is allowed per room, with a maximum weight of 15.0 kgs.
